data.one_liner: Create Inquirer.js-style CLI prompts and tests in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to build interactive command-line interface prompts with support for basic questions, boolean questions, lists, messages, custom ordering, and navigation mode. It also provides testing infrastructure using mock IO services.
use_when: You are building a command-line tool in Dart and need interactive user prompts.
You need features like list selections, boolean prompts, and navigation modes in a terminal interface.
avoid_when: You are building a Flutter GUI application.
You require advanced multi-platform UI widget kits.
strengths: Supports multiple question types including text, boolean, and lists.
Includes testing infrastructure via mockable I/O services.
Features a navigation mode allowing users to jump between questions.
weaknesses: Windows platform has minor caveats regarding colors and indicators.
